rationale: DESeq2 with median-of-ratios inside the model, apeglm shrinkage, and BH at 0.05 fit an unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch count design, and the QC keeps sample_01 with library sizes, PCA/distances, and a documented sensitivity re-run rather than default exclusion. The plan correctly uses the mouse MSigDB Hallmark (MGI symbol) collection and fgsea preranked on the full list with a named statistic, but omits the MSigDB version, the 15–500 set-size window, and an explicit ORA universe. No low-count filter is stated anywhere, the design formula and reference level are never written out, the |log2FC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than as lfcThreshold, and package versions are not requested in the report.
